fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s1.heading: U thomiwa ha Permaculture
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s1.body[0]: Musi ni sa athu u gwa, zwi a thusa u ḓivha uri tsheo dzi dzhiiwa hani.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s1.body[1]: Modulu uyu ndi mutheo wa zwoṱhe zwiṅwe kha ngudo ino. Ethics tharu, tshigwada tsha design principles, na nḓila nthihi yo leluwaho ya u dzudzanya land yaṋu.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s1.body[2]: A zwi ṱoḓi tshelede. Zwoṱhe zwi shandula hune na vhea zwithu, na uri ni tshimbila vhukale vhu ngafhani ḓuvha ḽiṅwe na ḽiṅwe.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s1.body[3]: Humbulani nga ha tsimu yaṋu. Ndi tshipiḓa tshifhio tshine na tshi dalela lunzhi?
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s2.heading: Ndi ngani hezwi zwi zwa ndeme
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s2.body[0]: Design yavhuḓi i fhungudza mushumo ni sa athu u fara spade.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s2.body[1]: Mushumo munzhi kha bulasi ḽiṱuku a si wa u zwala kana u kaṋa. Ndi wa u tshimbila, u hwala na u lugisa zwe zwa vhewa fhethu hu songo teaho.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s2.body[2]: Permaculture ndi nḓila ya u dzhia tsheo ya hune zwithu zwa tea u vha hone, uri mavu a shume na inwi, hu si u ni thivhela.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s2.body[3]: Humbulani nga mushumo muthihi bulasini yaṋu une wa dzhia tshifhinga tshilapfu u fhira tshine tsha ṱoḓea. Tshifhinga tshi khou ya ngafhi zwa vhukuma?
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s3.heading: Mvelelo dza Ngudo
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s3.body[0]: Musi modzhulu uyu wo no fhela, ni ḓo kona u ita zwithu zwiraru.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s3.body[1]: Bulani Ethics tharu, ni dzi shumise u dzhia tsheo ine ya si vhe na phindulo i vhonalaho.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s3.body[2]: Bulani design principles dzi re dza ndeme nga maanḓa kha land yaṋu, ni bule na uri ndi ngani.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s3.body[3]: Olani zones na sectors dzaṋu kha bammbiri ḽithihi.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s3.body[4]: Tshifanyiso itsho ndi mutheo wa pulane iṅwe na iṅwe ine na ḓo i ita nga murahu ha izwi.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s4.heading: U Ṱhogomela Mavu na Mupo (Earth Care)
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s4.body[0]: Mulayo wa vhuḓifari wa u thoma ndi U Ṱhogomela Mavu na Mupo (Earth Care).
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s4.body[1]: Zwi amba u dzhia mavu, maḓi, zwimela na zwipuka sa “living systems dza u tsireledza, hu si resources dza u fhedza nga u shumisa.”
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s4.body[2]: System ine na shumisa na fhedza i a ima: “a i tsha ni badela.” System ine na tsireledza i bvela phanda: “i bvela phanḓa u ni badela.”
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s4.body[3]: Sedzani tshipiḓa tshithihi tsha mavu a songo tibedzwaho tsimuni yaṋu. Hu na tshithu tshine tsha khou tsireledza mavu eneo zwino?
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s5.heading: U Ṱhogomela Vhathu (People Care)
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s5.body[0]: Mulayo wa vhuḓifari wa vhuvhili ndi U Ṱhogomela Vhathu (People Care).
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s5.body[1]: Ṱhoḓea dza muṱa waṋu dzi ḓa u thoma, nga murahu hu tevhela dza tshitshavha tsha haṋu.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s5.body[2]: Murimi ane a rengisa makumba oṱhe na miroho yoṱhe, a si vhee na tshithu tsha uḽa ha muṱa, ha tevheli People Care.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s5.body[3]: Bulasi ḽo itelwa u ṋea zwiḽiwa muṱa une wa ḽi shumisa.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s5.body[4]: Ndi mini zwine zwa bva shangoni ḽaṋu zwine muṱa waṋu wa sa vhuye wa zwiḽa?
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s6.heading: U Kovhelana ho Fanelaho (Fair Share)
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s6.body[0]: Mulayo wa vhuḓifari wa vhuraru ndi U Kovhelana ho Fanelaho (Fair Share).
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s6.body[1]: Dzhiani fhedzi zwine na zwi ṱoḓa, nahone vhuedzedzani surplus kha system — mbeu, zwiḽiwa, maḓi, nḓivho.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s6.body[2]: Mulimi ane a rengisa mielies dzawe dzoṱhe dza surplus, a si vhulunge na tshithu tsha compost kana mbeu, u khou pfuka uyu mulayo. A hu na tshithu tshi vhuyelelaho.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s6.body[3]: Tshitshavha tshi vhofhaho tsime ḽine ḽa shumiswa nga vhoṱhe nga fence tshi khou pfuka Fair Share na tshone.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s6.body[4]: Land yaṋu i wana mini kha inwi kha khalaṅwaha iṅwe na iṅwe?
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s7.heading: Sedzani: Tsheo Nthihi, Ethics Tharu
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s7.body[0]: Borehole i shumela muṱa waṋu. Vhahura vha khou humbela maḓi na vhone.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s7.body[1]: Thomani nga u wana arali u kovhelana ho tendelwa. Ṱolani arali borehole i nga kona u shumela vhashumisi vhoṱhe hu si na u dzhia maḓi manzhi lwo kalaho. Arali u kovhelana ho tendelwa nahone hu na maḓi o eḓanaho, tendelanani uri ni kovhelane nga ndinganyo ni dzule ni tshi sedza vhuimo ha maḓi. People Care na Fair Share zwi livhisa u tendelana. Earth Care zwi amba u tsireledza tshiko. U sedza vhuimo ha maḓi fhedzi a zwi ambi uri u shumisa maḓi o engedzeaho zwi safe kana zwo tendelwa.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s7.body[2]: Ndi nnyi ane a nga ni thusa u sedza milayo na mphakelo wa maḓi?
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s8.heading: Musi hu si na bugu ya milayo
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s8.body[0]: Hezwi ndi zwone zwine milayo ya vhuḓifari ya itelwa zwone.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s8.body[1]: Muhura u humbela u fulisa kholomo nga murahu ha gomelelo. Mandindi a tshinyadza dzi-swale dzaṋu. A hu na muthu o ṅwalaho phindulo.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s8.body[2]: Milayo ya vhuḓifari i ni thusa u pima khetho na u ṱalutshedza tsheo yaṋu. Ṱolani milayo nahone ni humbele thendelo hune zwa ṱoḓea hone.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s8.body[3]: Dzhiani ethics idzi tharu ni dzi ite tshipiḓa tsha nḓila ine na humbula ngayo, ni sa athu fhaṱa zwithu kha mavu.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s9.heading: Milayo ya fumi-mbili
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s9.body[0]: David Holmgren o vhea milayo ya fumi-mbili ya nzudzanyo (twelve design principles) kha Essence of Permaculture. Bill Mollison na David Holmgren vho thoma muhumbulo wa permaculture vhothe.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s9.body[1]: A zwi ṱoḓi uri ni vhe na yoṱhe ya fumi-mbili u itela u thoma. Zwipiḓa zwiraru zwavhuḓi zwa u thoma ngudo ino ndi: u lavhelesa na u shumisana (observe and interact), u fara na u vhulunga maanḓa (catch and store energy), na u shumisa mikombero na u dzhiela nṱha zwipiḓa zwa thungo (use edges and value the marginal).
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s9.body[2]: Ri ḓo dzhia hezwo zwiraru tshithihi nga tshithihi.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s10.heading: Observe and Interact
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s10.body[0]: Sedzani land yaṋu kha khalaṅwaha yoṱhe ni sa athu u ḓiṋekedza kha major earthworks.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s10.body[1]: Ḓumbu ḽithihi ḽi sumbedza tshifhinga tshithihi. Khalaṅwaha ya mvula yoṱhe i sumbedza pattern: hune maḓi a elela, hune a kuvhangana, na hune a sa swike hone.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s10.body[2]: Izwi zwi thusa uri ni pfesese site. Fhedzi izwi fhedzi a zwi sumbedzi uri swale yo tea kana yo safe u fhaṱiwa. Ni sa athu cela, sedzani mavu, slope, drainage na safe overflow route ine ya sa ise kha erosion kana u rumela maḓi a tshinyadzaho kha vhahura. Humbelani mueletshedzi wa henefho o gudedzwaho uri a sedze site.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s10.body[3]: Maḓi a bva ngafhi kha land yaṋu? Ni a ḓivha zwa vhukuma, kana ni khou humbulela?
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s11.heading: Ni fare nahone ni vhulunge maanḓa
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s11.body[0]: Harvest mvula, ḓuvha na biomass before they leave your property.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s11.body[1]: Zwoṱhe izwi zwi swika mahala, zwa dovha zwa ṱuwa mahala. Maḓi a elela a tshi bva, maṱari a fhufha a tshi ṱuwa, ḓuvha ḽi wela kha mavu a songo fukedzwaho.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s11.body[2]: Vhambedzani the cost and work with the benefit kha bulasi yaṋu.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s11.body[3]: Bulani tshithu tshithihi tshine tsha swika kha mavu aṋu mahala tsha dovha tsha ṱuwa tshi songo shumiswa.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s12.heading: Ni shumise mikano nahone ni dzhiele nṱha zwa magumoni
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s12.body[0]: The edge ndi hune zwithu zwivhili zwa ṱangana — muduba wa fence kana tshipiḓa tshi re tsini na nḓila (strip).
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s12.body[1]: Hezwi zwi nga vha fhethu hu vhuedzaho ha u sedza. Sedzani zwine zwa mela zwavhuḓi kha edge yaṋu. That is the land telling you something.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s12.body[2]: Ndi edge ifhio ya plot yaṋu ine zwa zwino ya si shume tshithu?
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s13.heading: Ni shumise nahone ni dzhiele nṱha u fhambana
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s13.body[0]: Shumisani diversity ni i dzhiele nṱha. Hail injury kha maize i ya nga ḓumbu na growth stage ya crop. Principle iyi a i fulufhedzisi uri crop i ḓo ponyoka kha tshiwo tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s13.body[1]: Maṅwe maitele mavhili ane zwa vhuedza u a ḓivha ndi haya: produce no waste, ngauralo masalela a vha compost na compost ya vha mavu. Nahone use small and slow solutions — bakete ḽi nga sheledza bed hu si na muḓagasi na luthihi.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s13.body[2]: Ḓuvha ḽithihi ḽivhi ḽi nga ni durisa mini zwino?
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s14.heading: Ni ṱanganye nṱhani ha u fhambanya
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s14.body[0]: Vheani tshithu tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe (each element) fhethu hune tsha shumela zwi re tsini natsho (its neighbours).
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s14.body[1]: Serapa, miri ya mitshelo na chicken run zwi nga dzudzanywa uri khuhu dzi rotate through the beds nga murahu ha harvest; izwi ndi integration. Ni songo tendela khuhu dzi tshi swika kha crops dzine dza khou harvestiwa uri dzi ḽiwe. Fresh manure i nga hwalela germs. Vhudzisani mueletshedzi wa extension uri bed i langulwe hani safely, crops dzine dza ḽiwa dzi sa athu vhuya. Khuhu dzi nga thusa u bvisa pests na u engedza fertility, nṱhani ha uri dzi dzule dzi sa shumi kha pen yo dzulaho fhethu huthihi.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s14.body[2]: Izwi zwithu zwiraru, zwo fhandekanywaho nga fence, zwi ita mushumo wa tshone tshithihi tshithihi fhedzi.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s14.body[3]: Khethani maitele mavhili kana mararu ane a amba na thaidzo yaṋu khulwane ni a shumise nga maanḓa. Maṅwe a ḓo tou vha khagala musi ni tshi bvela phanḓa.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s15.heading: Zones: U Dzudzanya u Ya nga uri Ni Dalela Lunzhi-lini
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s15.body[0]: Zones dzi bva kha 0 u ya kha 5, nahone ndi nga ha u tshimbila haṋu, hu si fences yaṋu.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s15.body[1]: Zone 0 ndi nḓu. Kha hei tsumbo, Zone 1 i tsini na nḓu nahone i na herbs na salad greens zwine na zwi kaṋa lunzhi.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s15.body[2]: Zone 2 ndi main garden na chicken run, ni zwi dalela luthihi kana luvhili nga ḓuvha. Zone 3 ndi main field, ni i dalela vhege iṅwe na iṅwe.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s15.body[3]: Zone 4 ndi semi-wild: miri ya mitshelo na fodder zwine zwa ṱoḓa ṱhogomelo nga zwiṅwe zwifhinga. Zone 5 i sala i wild.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s16.heading: Vheani Crops dzine na dzi Shumisa Ḓuvha ḽiṅwe na ḽiṅwe Tsini
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s16.body[0]: Herbs dzine na dzi kaṋa lunzhi dzi a leluwa u dzi ṱhogomela dzi tsini na nḓu.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s16.body[1]: Arali na dzi vhea kule, lwendo lulapfu lu nga ita uri ni kundelwe u dzi dalela. Herbs dzi nga litshelelwa.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s16.body[2]: Humbulani nga nḓila dzine na tshimbila khadzo ḓuvha ḽiṅwe na ḽiṅwe.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s16.body[3]: Ndi zwifhio zwine na zwi dalela kanzhi zwine zwa nga vha tsini?
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s17.heading: Zones dzi Dzudzanya Mushumo waṋu
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s17.body[0]: Ndivho ya nyito yoṱhe ndi iyi.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s17.body[1]: Zones zwi thusa u dzudzanya fhethu u ya nga mushumo waṋu — u tshimbila, u hwala na u sedza zwine zwa ḓadza ḓuvha ḽa vhukuma.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s17.body[2]: Tshithu tshi ni ṱoḓaho lunzhi tshi dzula tsini na inwi. Zwenezwo zwi nga fhungudza u tshimbila na mushumo kha khalaṅwaha.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s17.body[3]: Imani muṋangoni wa khishini. Ndi zwifhio zwine na swikelela khazwo ni sa humbuli?
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s18.heading: Dzisekithara (Sectors): Maanḓa A Bvaho Nnḓa
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s18.body[0]: Zones dzi bva ngomu ha land yaṋu. Sectors dzi bva nnḓa ha yona.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s18.body[1]: Ḓuvha, muya, mvula, flood na mulilo zwi pfuka boundary yaṋu hu sa londwi arali ni tshi zwi pulanela kana hai.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s18.body[2]: Sedzani hune muya u re na maanḓa u bva hone kha bulasi yaṋu. Rekhodo dza weather station ya tsini dzi nga ni thusa u sedza thungo ya muya. Sedzani hune maḓi a mvula a dzhena hone na hune a elela hone kha mavu aṋu.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s18.body[3]: Mutsho une wa ni vhaisa u bva lufhio lurumbu?
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s19.heading: Ṱolisisani: Tsireledzo Vhukati Ha Muya Na Zwimela
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s19.body[0]: Sedzani uyu tsumbo. Muya u bva north-west.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s19.body[1]: Miri na shrubs dzi ima vhukati ha muya uyo na crops.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s19.body[2]: Muṅwe muya u fhira nga ngomu ha windbreak. Muṅwe u ya nṱha ha yone kana u mona na magumo ayo.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s19.body[3]: Tsireledzo i nga fhungudza luvhilo lwa muya nga murahu hayo. Design na u ṱhogomela windbreak ndi zwa ndeme.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s19.body[4]: Kha site yaṋu, ṱhogomelani meya i tshinyadzaho ni sa athu khetha hune na ṱavha hone. Tshifanyiso itshi a si planting plan.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s20.heading: Zwi Olani Ndi Hone Ni Tshi Vha Na Nzudzanyo (Design)
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s20.body[0]: Olani mukano waṋu. Maka nnḓu. Olani rings dzi tshi ya nnḓa u ya nga uri ni dalela hani lunzhi.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s20.body[1]: Nga murahu olani misevhe i tshi dzhena i tshi bva nnḓa u sumbedza ḓuvha, muya, mulilo na maḓi.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s20.body[2]: Bammbiri iḽi ndi mutheo wa pulane yaṋu. Zwiṅwe zwoṱhe kha ngudo iyi zwi fhaṱiwa khaḽo.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s20.body[3]: A zwi ṱoḓei uri zwi vhe zwo naka tshoṱhe. Zwi tea u vha ngoho.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s21.heading: Mushumo Wa Masimuni
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s21.body[0]: Olani zones na sectors dzaṋu kha bammbiri ḽithihi.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s21.body[1]: Maka Zone 0 na Zone 1 u thome, ni bvele nga nnḓa u swika hune land yaṋu ya guma hone.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s21.body[2]: Engedzani musevhe muthihi kha energy iṅwe na iṅwe ine ya swika i tshi bva nnḓa, ni ṅwale hune ya bva hone.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s22.heading: Nyito Masimuni
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s22.body[0]: Tshimbilani ni sedzani nyolo yaṋu ni tshi i vhambedza na ground ya vhukuma.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s22.body[1]: Imani munyangoni wa khishi ni vhale zwine zwa vha zwa vhukuma kha Zone 1 namusi.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s22.body[2]: Wanani tshithu tshithihi tsho ṱavhiwaho further away than how often you use it, ni ṅwale hune tsha tea u pfuluselwa hone.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ve:s22.body[3]: Nga murahu ni humbele older neighbour muthihi uri a ni vhudze sia ine worst wind ya bva ngaḽo, ni vhambedze phindulo yawe na musevhe waṋu.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s1.heading: Masungulo ya Permaculture
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s1.body[0]: U nga si cela, swi pfuna ku tiva leswaku swiboho swi endliwa hi ndlela yihi.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s1.body[1]: Modulu lowu i xisekelo xa swilo leswin’wana eka dyondzo leyi. Ethics tinharhu, ntlawa wa design principles, na ndlela yin’we yo olova yo hlela land ya wena.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s1.body[2]: A swi lavi mali. Hinkwaswu swi cinca laha u vekaka swilo kona ni leswaku u famba mpfhuka wo fika kwihi siku rin’wana ni rin’wana.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s1.body[3]: Ehleketa hi nsimu ya wena. Hi xihi xiphemu xa yona lexi u xi endzelaka ngopfu?
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s2.heading: Ha yini leswi swi ri swa nkoka
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s2.body[0]: Dizayini leyinene yi hunguta ntirhokulu u nga si sungula ku cela.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s2.body[1]: Ntirho wo tala eka purasi leritsongo a hi ku byala kumbe ku tshovela. I ku famba, ku rhwala ni ku lulamisa leswi vekiweke endhawini leyi hoxeke.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s2.body[2]: Permaculture i ndlela yo teka swiboho hi laha swilo swi faneleke ku vekiwa kona, leswaku misava yi tirha na wena ku nga ri ku lwisana na wena.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s2.body[3]: Ehleketa hi ntirho wun'we epurasini ra wena lowu tekaka nkarhi wo tala ku nga ri na xilaveko. Nkarhi wolowo wu ya kwihi hakunene?
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s3.heading: Swikongomelo swa dyondzo
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s3.body[0]: Loko modulu lowu wu hela, u ta kota ku endla swilo swinharhu.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s3.body[1]: Boxa milawu ya mahanyelo yinharhu, u yi tirhisa ku endla xiboho lexi nga riki na nhlamulo leyi vonakaka hi ku olova.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s3.body[2]: Boxa design principles ta nkoka ngopfu eka land ya wena, u vula leswaku ha yini.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s3.body[3]: Dirowa zones na sectors ta wena eka phepha rin’we.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s3.body[4]: Xifaniso xexo hi xona xisekelo xa pulani yin'wana ni yin'wana leyi u nga ta yi endla endzhaku ka leswi.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s4.heading: Ku Hlayisa Misava (Earth Care)
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s4.body[0]: Nawu wo sungula wa mahanyelo i Ku Hlayisa Misava (Earth Care).
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s4.body[1]: Swi vula ku teka misava, mati, swimilana na swiharhi tani hi “living systems to sirhelela, ku nga ri resources to heta hi ku tirhisa.”
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s4.body[2]: System leyi u yi tirhisaka yi hela, kutani “a ya ha ku hakeli.” System leyi u yi sirhelelaka ya ya mahlweni, kutani “yi ya mahlweni yi ku hakela.”
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s4.body[3]: Languta xiphemu xin'we xa misava leyi nga funengetiwangiki epurasini ra wena. Xana ku na lexi xi yi sirhelelaka sweswi?
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s5.heading: Ku Hlayisa Vanhu (People Care)
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s5.body[0]: Nawu wa vumbirhi wa mahanyelo i Ku Hlayisa Vanhu (People Care).
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s5.body[1]: Swilaveko swa ndyangu wa wena swi ta rhanga, ivi swa vaaki va wena swi landzela.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s5.body[2]: Murimi la xavaka tandza hinkwato ni matsavu hinkwato, kambe a nga hlayisi na xin'we leswaku ndyangu wu ta dya, a nga landzeli People Care.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s5.body[3]: Purasi ri endleriwe ku phamela swakudya ndyangu lowu wu ri fambisaka.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s5.body[4]: I yini leswi humaka epurasini ra wena leswi ndyangu wa wena wu nga swi dyiki?
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s6.heading: Ku Avelana hi Ku Ringana (Fair Share)
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s6.body[0]: Nawu wa vunharhu wa mahanyelo i Ku Avelana hi Ku Ringana (Fair Share).
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s6.body[1]: Teka ntsena leswi u swi lavaka, kutani vuyisela leswi saleke eka system — mbewu, swakudya, mati, vutivi.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s6.body[2]: Murimi loyi a xaviselaka mielies ya yena leyi saleke yi hundzaka leswi a swi lavaka hinkwaro, a nga hlayisi ni xin’we xa compost kumbe mbewu, u tshova nawu lowu. A ku na lexi tlheleleke.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s6.body[3]: Vaaki lava va pfangaka xihlovo lexi va xi tirhisaka swin’we hi fence na vona va tshova Fair Share.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s6.body[4]: Land ya wena yi kuma yini eka wena eka nguva yin’wana ni yin’wana?
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s7.heading: Languta: Xiboho Xin’we, Ethics Tinharhu
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s7.body[0]: Borehole yi tirhela ndyangu wa wena. Vahakelani na vona va kombela mati.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s7.body[1]: Sungula hi ku kuma leswaku ku avelana swa pfumeleriwa kumbe e-e. Kambela loko borehole yi nga tirhela vatirhisi hinkwavo handle ko teka mati yo tala ngopfu. Loko ku avelana ku pfumeleriwa naswona ku ri na mati yo ringana, pfumelelani ndlela ya ku avelana hi ku ringana, mi ya mahlweni mi languta xiyimo xa mati. People Care na Fair Share swi kongomisa ntwanano. Earth Care swi vula ku sirhelela xihlovo. Ku languta xiyimo xa mati ntsena a swi endli leswaku ku tirhisa mati yo engetela swi va safe kumbe swi pfumeleriwa.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s7.body[2]: I mani loyi a nga ku pfuna ku kambela milawu ni mphakelo wa mati?
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s8.heading: Loko ku nga ri na Buku ya Milawu
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s8.body[0]: Hi swona leswi milawu ya mahanyelo yi pfunaka swona hakunene.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s8.body[1]: Muakelani u kombela ku risa tihomu endzhaku ka dyandza. Ndhambi yi onha swisele (swales) swa wena. A ku na munhu loyi a tsaleke nhlamulo.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s8.body[2]: Milawu ya mahanyelo yi ku pfuna ku pima swihlawuriwa ni ku hlamusela xiboho xa wena. Kambela milawu kutani u kombela mpfumelelo laha swi lavekaka kona.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s8.body[3]: Veka ethics leti tinharhu eka ndlela leyi u ehleketaka ha yona u nga si sungula ku aka ehandle.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s9.heading: Misinya ya Milawu ya Khume-Mbirhi
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s9.body[0]: David Holmgren u hlamusele misinya ya milawu ya design ya khume-mbirhi eka Essence of Permaculture. Bill Mollison na David Holmgren va sungula nongoti wa permaculture swin’we.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s9.body[1]: A swi lavi ku sungula hi hinkwato ta 12. Kha dyondzo leyi, ku na tindlela tinharhu leti pfunaka ku sungula: observe and interact, catch and store energy, na use edges and value the marginal.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s9.body[2]: Hi ta teka sweswo swinharhu hi xin'we hi xin'we.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s10.heading: Observe and Interact
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s10.body[0]: Languta land ya wena eka nguva leyi heleleke u nga si tinyiketela eka major earthworks.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s10.body[1]: Xidzedze xin’we xi ku komba nkarhi wun’we. Nguva ya mpfula leyi heleleke yi ku komba pattern: laha mati ya khulukaka, laha ya hlengeletanaka kona, ni laha ma nga fiki kona nikatsongo.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s10.body[2]: Leswi swi ku pfuna ku twisisa ndhawu. Kambe leswi ntsena a swi kombisi loko swale yi faneleka kumbe yi safe ku akiwa. U nga si cela, kambela misava, slope, drainage na safe overflow route leyi nga ta ka yi nga vangisi erosion kumbe ku rhumela mati lama onhaka eka vaakelani. Kombela mutsundzuxi wa le ndhawini loyi a leteriweke a kambela ndhawu.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s10.body[3]: Xana mati ma huma hi kwihi eka land ya wena? Xana wa swi tiva hakunene kumbe wa bvumbetela?
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s11.heading: Catch and Store Energy
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s11.body[0]: Harvest mpfula, dyambu na biomass before they leave your property.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s11.body[1]: Hinkwato swi fika mahala swi tlhela swi famba mahala. Mati ma khuluka ma huma, matluka ma haha ma ya, dyambu ri wela eka misava leyi nga funengetiwangiki.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s11.body[2]: Pimanisa  cost na ntirho ni mbuyelo epurasini ra wena.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s11.body[3]: Vula xilo xin'we lexi fikaka epurasini ra wena mahala, kutani xi tlhela xi suka xi nga tirhisiwanga.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s12.heading: Use Edges and Value the Marginal
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s12.body[0]: The edge hi laha swilo swimbirhi swi hlanganaka kona — layini ya fence kumbe xiphemu xa misava lexi nga etlhelo ka ndlela (strip).
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s12.body[1]: Leswi swi nga va tindhawu letinene to languta. Languta leswi se swi kulaka kahle etlhelo ka edge ya wena. Yoleyo i land leyi ku byelaka swin’wana.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s12.body[2]: Hi yihi edge eka plot ya wena leyi nga endli xin’wana sweswi?
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s13.heading: Use and Value Diversity
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s13.body[0]: Tirhisa diversity u tlhela u yi teka yi ri ya nkoka. Ku onhaka ka maize hi xihangu swi ya hi xidzedze na growth stage ya crop. Principle leyi a yi tiyisisi leswaku crop yi ta pona eka xiendlakalo xin’wana ni xin’wana.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s13.body[1]: Ku na swin’wana swimbirhi leswi swi nga swinene ku swi tiva: produce no waste, hikokwalaho masalela ma hundzuka compost na compost yi hundzuka misava. Naswona use small and slow solutions — bakiti ri nga cheleta bed handle ka gezi nikatsongo.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s13.body[2]: Xana siku rin’we ro biha ri nga ku durhela yini sweswi?
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s14.heading: Integrate Rather Than Segregate
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s14.body[0]: Veka element yin’wana ni yin’wana laha yi tirhaka kona na leswi nga ekusuhi na yona.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s14.body[1]: Ntanga, mirhi ya mihandzu na chicken run swi nga veketeriwa leswaku tihuku ti rotate through the beds endzhaku ka harvest; leswi i integration. U nga pfumeleli tihuku ti tshinela eka crops leti ku tshoveriwaka swakudya. Fresh manure yi nga rhwala germs. Kombela mutsundzuxi wa extension a ku hlamusela ndlela yo hlayisa bed yi ri safe loko crops leti dyiwaka ti nga si vuya. Tihuku ti nga basisa pests ti tlhela ti engetela fertility, ematshan’weni yo tshama ti nga endli swo karhi eka pen leyi nga endhawini yin’we.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s14.body[2]: Swilo leswi swinharhu, loko swi pfariwe hi fence swi hambanisiwile, xin’wana ni xin’wana xi endla ntirho wa xona ntsena.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s14.body[3]: Hlawula misinya ya milawu yimbirhi kumbe yinharhu leyi khumbaka xiphiqo xa wena lexikulu u yi tirhisa hi ku tiyimisela. Leyin’wana yi ta vonaka kahle loko u ya mahlweni.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s15.heading: Zones: Ku Hlela hi ku ya hi Leswaku U Endzela Kangani
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s15.body[0]: Zones ti suka eka 0 ku ya eka 5, naswona ti khumba ku famba ka wena, ku nga ri ti-fence ta wena.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s15.body[1]: Zone 0 i yindlu. Eka xikombiso lexi, Zone 1 yi le kusuhi ni yindlu naswona yi na herbs na salad greens leti u ti tshovelaka nkarhi ni nkarhi.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s15.body[2]: Zone 2 i main ntanga ni chicken run, u ya eka swona kan’we kumbe kambirhi hi siku. Zone 3 i main nsimu, u ya kona vhiki na vhiki.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s15.body[3]: Zone 4 i semi-wild: mirhi ya mihandzu na fodder leswi lavaka nyingiso minkarhi yin’wana. Zone 5 yi tshikiwa yi ri wild.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s16.heading: Hlayisa Crops leti u ti Tirhisaka Siku na Siku Ekusuhi
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s16.body[0]: Herbs leti u ti tshovelaka nkarhi ni nkarhi swa olova ku ti hlayisa loko ti ri ekusuhi ni yindlu.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s16.body[1]: Loko u ti veka ekule, riendzo ro leha ri nga endla leswaku u nga ti endzeli. herbs ti nga siyiwa ti nga hlayisiwi.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s16.body[2]: Ehleketa hi tindlela leti u fambaka eka tona siku rin'wana ni rin'wana.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s16.body[3]: I yini lexi u xi endzelaka ngopfu lexi a xi fanele ku va ekusuhi?
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s17.heading: Zones ti Pulana Ntirho wa Wena
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s17.body[0]: Hi xona xikongomelo xa ntirho lowu hinkwawo.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s17.body[1]: Zones ti pfuna ku lulamisa ndhawu hi ku ya hi matshalatshala ya wena — ku famba, ku rhwala ni ku kambela leswi tata siku ra xiviri.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s17.body[2]: Loko xin’wana xi ku lava nkarhi ni nkarhi, xi tshama ekusuhi na wena. Sweswo swi nga hunguta ku famba ni ku tirha eka nguva.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s17.body[3]: Yima enyangweni ya khixi. I yini lexi u nga xi fikeleraka handle ko ehleketa?
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s18.heading: Sectors: Energies leti Fikaka ku Suka Ehandle
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s18.body[0]: Zones ti huma endzeni ka land ya wena. Sectors ti huma ehandle ka yona.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s18.body[1]: Dyambu, moya, mpfula, ndhambi na ndzilo swi tsemakanya ndzilakana wa wena hambi u swi pulanile kumbe a wu swi pulananga.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s18.body[2]: Languta laha moya wa matimba wu humaka kona epurasini ra wena. Matsalwa ya weather station ya le kusuhi ma nga ku pfuna ku kambela tlhelo leri moya wu humaka eka rona. Languta laha mati ya mpfula ma nghenaka kona ni ndlela leyi ma khulukaka ha yona eka misava ya wena.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s18.body[3]: Xana maxelo lama ku onhaka ma huma hi tlhelo rihi?
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s19.heading: Xiyisisa: Nsirhelelo Exikarini ka Moya ni Swibyariwa
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s19.body[0]: Languta xikombiso lexi. Moya wu huma hi north-west.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s19.body[1]: Mirhi na shrubs swi yima exikarhi ka moya wolowo ni swibyariwa.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s19.body[2]: Moya wun’wana wu hundza hi le ka windbreak. Moya wun’wana wu famba ehenhla ka yona kumbe wu rhendzela makumu ya yona.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s19.body[3]: Nsirhelelo yi nga hunguta rivilo ra moya endzhaku ka yona. Design ni ku hlayisiwa ka windbreak swi na nkoka.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s19.body[4]: Eka site ya wena, languta mimoya leyi onhaka u nga si hlawula laha u nga ta byala kona. Xifaniso lexi a hi planting plan.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s20.heading: Dirowa Swona Kutani U Va na Design
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s20.body[0]: Dirowa ndzilakana wa wena. Maka yindlu. Dirowa rings u ya ehandle hi ku ya hi leswaku u endzela ndhawu yin’wana ni yin’wana kangani.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s20.body[1]: Kutani dirowa miseve leti nghenaka ti huma ehandle ku yimela dyambu, moya, ndzilo na mati.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s20.body[2]: Phepha leri ri khoma skeleton ya design ya wena. Hinkwaswo swin’wana eka khoso leyi swi titshege hi rona.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s20.body[3]: A swi bohi leswaku swi va leswi hlelekeke. Swi fanele swi fambisana ni leswi nga kona hakunene.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s21.heading: Ntirho lowu Nyikiweke wa le Nsimwini
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s21.body[0]: Dirowa zones na sectors ta wena eka phepha rin’we.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s21.body[1]: Maka Zone 0 na Zone 1 ku sungula, kutani u ya ehandle ku fika laha land ya wena yi helelaka kona.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s21.body[2]: Engetela museve wun’we eka energy yin’wana ni yin’wana leyi fikaka yi huma ehandle, u tsala laha yi humaka kona.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s21.body[3]: Tekela xifaniso xa sketch ya wena.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s22.heading: Xiendlo xa le Nsimwini
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s22.body[0]: Famba ehandle u kambela sketch ya wena u yi pimanisa ni misava ya xiviri.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s22.body[1]: Yima enyangweni ya khixi u hlayela leswi nga kona hakunene eka Zone 1 namuntlha.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s22.body[2]: Kuma xilo xin’we lexi byariweke further away than how often you use it, u tsala laha xi faneleke ku rhurhiseriwa kona.
fullPairedProposedTargetMap.deck:ts:s22.body[3]: Endzhaku kombela older neighbour un’we a ku hlamusela tlhelo leri worst wind yi humaka hi yona, u ringanisa nhlamulo ya yena ni museve wa wena.
